title: Recently discovered 10,000-year-old ancient city in Texas

tellings.quote: There's a there's a there's an ancient city in Texas that was discovered recently that's 10,000 years old next to this river.

plain: A 10,000-year-old ancient city was discovered recently in Texas, next to a river, according to the researcher Luke Caverns. He mentions it to Michels in passing, without naming the place, the river or a source. He raises it as a sign that civilisation in the Americas goes back much further than is usually thought.
